color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Color register confirmed light (pageBackground #f2f2f2, luminance 242 > 190 threshold).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist C (Heading font weight shift): h1 fontWeight shifted from 500 to 700 (+200, intensity 3). All woff2 src blocks replaced with Google Fonts CDN @import for Inter. Inter Fallback removed from fontFaces as it is a local system font reference only.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A (Duration scaling slower, ×1.5, intensity 3): primary logo transition 0.5s → 0.75s; work-item opacity transition 1s → 1.5s; button transition duration set to 0.75s. Easing (ease) preserved unchanged.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist C (Container padding change, +12px each side, intensity 3): paddingLeft 80px → 92px; paddingRight 80px → 92px. maxWidth 1440px unchanged. All responsive breakpoints preserved.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist A (Global scale factor ×1.2, intensity 2): all numeric padding, margin, and gap values multiplied by 1.2 and rounded to nearest integer. cta borderRadius (26px, purely geometric) preserved unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E (Focus state enhancement, outlineWidth 2px, intensity 3): added focus state with outlineWidth: '2px' and outlineStyle: 'solid' to all buttons, inputs, and link elements. No color values modified.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist A (Nav height adjustment +8px, intensity 2): height 44.789px → 52.789px. heightScrolled set to match. Additional geometry fields (itemSpacing, logoPosition) and typography fields added for completeness. No color values modified.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C (Material shift): rewrote the Typography System section to add specific physical materiality detail — ink traps, stroke resistance, embossed-seal weight, the tactile register of Inter 700 at heading scale. concept_by_video.md generated fresh: 5–7 paragraphs with three video placements (hero-bg.mp4 hero atmospheric, craft-detail.mp4 feature showcase, grain-field.mp4 manifesto background).
